column1: # Taxon ID -> taxonomic class, for the leave-one-clade-out splits of the adhesion benchmark.
# Explicit and reviewable: the benchmark holds a few dozen taxa, so this replaces an NCBI taxdump
# download. A taxon that is not listed makes build_benchmark.py exclude the row, so a new organism
# has to be classified here on purpose rather than landing in a wrong split by default.
# Microsporidia is used as the class-level group (its internal classes are not settled).
